fields.v: Yes (1): limitations discussed though not in a dedicated section: associations not causal effects (engineers choose spend), measurement error in commits (IV), setting limits transfer (one company building AI tools, established codebases, voluntary use), commits miss quality, review and design, five weeks too short, self-reported hours may be overstated
fields.quote: The setting may limit how far our estimates transfer. JetBrains builds AI coding tools, so some metered use may be testing of its own agents; its engineers work on established codebases, the type where He et al. report smaller AI gains [2]; and use was voluntary,
fields.why: The paper has no threats section, but internal, external and construct validity limits are each discussed explicitly, so the absence of a dedicated section may not justify Partly.
fields.doubt: Não há secção de ameaças, mas o artigo discute causalidade (pág. 3), erro de medida nos commits (pág. 4), transferibilidade (pág. 9), o que os commits não medem (pág. 4) e o exagero das horas autorreportadas (pág. 10). Decide se isto chega para Sim em Q10 ou se mantém Parcial.
